summary: The proposal is missing several mandatory sections, has an insufficient bibliography and figures, and contains major methodological and writing issues. Important corrections are required before it can be accepted.

findings.title: Missing Introduction section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Introduction section required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Missing Motivation section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain a Motivation section required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Missing Objective section with required subsections
findings.description: There is no Objective section that starts with a short introduction, a bullet list of 3‑4 high‑level objectives, and detailed subsections for each objective.

findings.title: Missing AI Transparency statement
findings.description: The proposal does not include an AI transparency statement, which is a mandatory component.

findings.title: Insufficient bibliography entries
findings.description: Only five bibliography entries are provided; the guidelines require at least six to eight peer‑reviewed publications.

locations.quote: [Booch95]     Booch,     G.       Object-oriented    analysis    and   design    with   applications   (2.   ed.).

findings.title: Insufficient number of figures
findings.description: The proposal contains only one figure (Figure 1), whereas at least two diagrams or figures are required.

locations.quote: Figure 1: Depiction of the top-level workfow of the interactions in relation to Artemis and GitLab CI

findings.title: No UML diagram present
findings.description: The required UML diagram (class, activity, component, etc.) is missing from the proposal.

findings.title: Figure 1 is not referenced in the text
findings.description: The only figure included (Figure 1) is never cited or discussed within the body of the proposal.

locations.quote: Figure 1: Depiction of the top-level workfow of the interactions in relation to Artemis and GitLab CI

findings.title: Problem section includes solution description
findings.description: The Problem section contains statements that describe a solution (e.g., migrating the CI server), which violates the rule that the problem description must not present solutions.

locations.quote: The CI server should be migrated to the VC server.

findings.title: Problem section does not identify actors
findings.description: The Problem section fails to name the stakeholders (e.g., instructors, students) and describe how the problem affects them.

locations.quote: The interactive learning platform Artemis is an approach to use interactive learning during large computer science classes ...

findings.title: Schedule includes thesis‑writing tasks
findings.description: The schedule lists activities such as "Writing...", "Thesis ready for review", and "Review finished", which are prohibited; the schedule must contain only research/development work.

locations.quote: November – 2nd week: Thesis ready for review

findings.title: Schedule includes separate requirements tasks
findings.description: The schedule contains a "Requirements (parallel to prototype implementation)" item, which violates the rule that no dedicated requirements‑gathering sprint is allowed.

findings.title: Schedule iterations not defined as 2‑4 week sprints
findings.description: The presented timeline groups work by months and weeks but does not clearly define iterative sprints of 2‑4 weeks each.

findings.title: Forbidden sentence starters used
findings.description: Multiple sentences begin with prohibited starters such as "Since" and "Because", which is not allowed.

locations.quote: Since the benefts of using CI are quite high and nearly half of the developers who do not use CI mention a lack of familiarity ...
Because the build plan is fetched from the API on each run ...

findings.title: Use of filler words
findings.description: The text contains filler and redundant words such as "Additionally", "Furthermore", and "In order to", which should be avoided.

locations.quote: Additionally, the base build plan is copied once after the student started the exercise ...
Furthermore, the CI service should be part of the VC server ...
